title: fewrd book
description: A fewrd recipe book written as data. Compile it with compile(data, { resolvers }) from 'fewrd'.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, e.g. ./node_modules/fewrd/book.schema.json. Ignored by compile.

version.description: Keys a cached reading. Change it whenever a change to the recipes can change output.

defs.description: Named pattern fragments: source only, no slashes, no flags. Reference one from any pattern or fragment as %{NAME}; it splices in as one unit.

pattern.description: A regex as /source/flags, e.g. "/C\\.?U\\.?P/iu". %{NAME} splices in a fragment from defs.

part.description: The part name this neighbour attaches as, e.g. label, date, unit.

rx.description: Written plainly: the engine pins it to the anchor's edge.

entity.description: What this recipe recognises; mentions carry it.

anchor.description: The value, strict. Its part is value (lead on a rest recipe).

left.description: Neighbours tried leftward from the anchor, in priority order.

right.description: Neighbours tried rightward from the anchor, in priority order.

requires.description: Parts that must attach, or the candidate is dropped.

resolve.description: Name of a resolver passed to compile: canonical value from the parts, or null (not this entity after all).

weak.description: Fills only the gaps the strong recipes leave.

rest.description: The mention runs from its anchor to the end of its level, and what follows is read again inside it. Neighbours are ignored.

glued.description: The anchor may start or end inside a word.
